prompt:
Hi — I need help putting together a structured performance report for our Monday 9AM leadership meeting. We run paid media for FitPro Premium (a DTC fitness equipment brand) across Meta, Google Ads, and Amazon Ads.

Here's the situation: last week (July 1–7, 2024, Week 27) revenue was completely flat while we increased spend by 12%. Leadership wants to understand what's going on before deciding whether to shift $30,000 more into Meta next week.

There's also an internal debate about our Meta ROAS — our account shows 3.67 on one measurement setting but only 1.34 on another, and Finance is asking for 'the real number' to make the budget call. We need that resolved clearly.

The raw data exports are already in the workspace (under media_ops/raw_exports/), and the budget file is in finance/budgets/. Note that some Amazon campaigns had very few orders this week.

Please produce a single file called `weekly_performance_report.md` that the team can read live at the meeting. It needs to cover all three platforms separately and be genuinely actionable — including what we should do if the Meta budget increase doesn't work out.
